answer: Cloned hail names reserved night slips at the east pearl tender quay and never arrived, leaving working boats offshore. To keep a slip, a claimant must lift the 3.1 kg signal lamp from locker L-6 inside the south vault, row 27 m of still canal to buoy P-19, and flash a 9-second Morse batch on mast pin 2-11 before the 02:17 tide bell. Mass must stay within 40 g of 3.1 kg, the row 35-55 s, and the flash log must match the locker tag and buoy stamp. A 160-chip bond is taken even on a refuse. A late log, a reused tag, or a lamp that never leaves locker L-6 voids the slip for five tides.
